name: rk3588-whisper
description: RK3588: Whisper base on the RKNN encoder at a 20 s window, decoder as a CPU ONNX graph with a KV cache. Best English long-form measured on this board (7.58% WER, RTF 0.061) — the transcription choice. For conversation prefer rk3588-whisper-10s, which cuts TTFT from ~300 ms to ~124 ms.
